name: Kato Unitrack (N)
description: Kato Unitrack is a metric, integrated-roadbed N-scale system. Lengths are encoded in the part name in millimeters (e.g. S62 = 62 mm straight; R249-22.5 = 249 mm radius, 22.5-degree arc). Code 80 rail. The North American (Kato USA) and Japanese (Kato JP) catalogs share geometry; some pieces are JP-only and are flagged in notes. Product codes are of the form '20-xxx'.

pieces.label: S29 straight (29.5 mm)
pieces.notes: Sold in a 4-pack assortment (20-091) along with other short fitter straights. S29 is exactly 29.5 mm despite the rounded number in the part name.

pieces.label: S33 straight (33 mm)
pieces.notes: Short fitter straight, sold in the 20-091 assortment pack.

pieces.label: S45.5 straight (45.5 mm)
pieces.notes: Short fitter straight, sold in the 20-091 assortment pack.

pieces.label: S62 straight (62 mm)
pieces.notes: Half-length straight (half of S124). Sold 4 per pack.

pieces.label: S64 straight (64 mm)
pieces.notes: Compensating straight used with #4 turnouts to produce parallel sidings on 33 mm centers. Sold in 20-092 turnout-side fitter pack.

pieces.label: S78 straight (78 mm)
pieces.notes: Standard-pack straight used to extend turnout legs. 4 per pack.

pieces.label: S124 straight (124 mm)
pieces.notes: The 'unit' Unitrack straight; most curve and turnout geometry chains off this length. 4 per pack.

pieces.label: S186 straight (186 mm)
pieces.notes: 1.5x the S124 length. 4 per pack.

pieces.label: S248 straight (248 mm)
pieces.notes: 2x S124. Sold 4 per pack.

pieces.label: S62F feeder straight (62 mm)
pieces.notes: S62 with built-in DC/DCC power feeder leads.

pieces.label: S124 rerailer / re-railer straight (124 mm)
pieces.notes: Rerailer ramp molded into a 124 mm straight. Marketed as 'Re-Railer Track'.

pieces.label: R150-30 curve (R150 mm, 30 deg)
pieces.notes: Tightest Kato N curve. Used for trolley/tram and tight industrial radii. Often sold as part of Compact Oval or trolley sets.

pieces.label: R150-45 curve (R150 mm, 45 deg)
pieces.notes: Tight tram/branch radius. JP-catalog-driven; available in North America via Kato USA imports.

pieces.label: R216-15 curve (R216 mm, 15 deg)
pieces.notes: Compact-radius curve, primary use is the Compact (V13/V14) sets.

pieces.label: R216-30 curve (R216 mm, 30 deg)
pieces.notes: Compact-radius curve.

pieces.label: R249-22.5 curve (R249 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: Innermost double-track radius (paired with R282 at 33 mm centers). 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R249-45 curve (R249 mm, 45 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R282-11.25 curve (R282 mm, 11.25 deg)
pieces.notes: Half-arc piece used to align with #4 turnout geometry.

pieces.label: R282-22.5 curve (R282 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: Outer radius of the inner double-track pair (R249 inner / R282 outer).

pieces.label: R282-45 curve (R282 mm, 45 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R315-22.5 curve (R315 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R315-45 curve (R315 mm, 45 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R348-22.5 curve (R348 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: Outer radius of the outer double-track pair (R315 inner / R348 outer).

pieces.label: R348-45 curve (R348 mm, 45 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R381-11.25 curve (R381 mm, 11.25 deg)
pieces.notes: Half-arc R381 used for triple-track geometry.

pieces.label: R381-22.5 curve (R381 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R381-45 curve (R381 mm, 45 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R414-11.25 curve (R414 mm, 11.25 deg)
pieces.notes: Half-arc R414 used for triple-track geometry.

pieces.label: R414-22.5 curve (R414 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R414-45 curve (R414 mm, 45 deg)
pieces.notes: 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R447-22.5 curve (R447 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: Triple-track outer companion to R381/R414. 4 per pack.

pieces.label: R480-15 curve (R480 mm, 15 deg)
pieces.notes: Used in Shinkansen / passenger-line geometry. JP-catalog-led; sold by Kato USA.

pieces.label: R480-22.5 curve (R480 mm, 22.5 deg)
pieces.notes: Wide-radius curve for high-speed/passenger geometry.

pieces.label: R718-15 curve (R718 mm, 15 deg)
pieces.notes: Very-wide-radius curve for mainline/high-speed scenes. Often paired with R790.

pieces.label: R790-6.22 easement curve (R790 mm, 6.22 deg)
pieces.notes: Easement / transition curve. Geometry sums with the R718 wide curves to produce smooth lead-ins. JP-catalog-driven; product code subject to verification.

pieces.label: V1 viaduct straight S248 (248 mm) on stone-pier viaduct
pieces.notes: Single-track viaduct straight. V-series elevates the standard S248 onto integrated stone piers. JP-only originally, distributed in NA via Kato USA.

pieces.label: V2 viaduct straight S124 (124 mm) on stone-pier viaduct
pieces.notes: Half-length viaduct straight.

pieces.label: V3 viaduct curve R282-45 on stone-pier viaduct
pieces.notes: Viaduct version of the R282-45 curve.

pieces.label: V4 double-track straight S248 on viaduct (33 mm centers)
pieces.notes: Double-track viaduct straight on integrated piers, 33 mm track centers. The 'V' label refers to the viaduct system.

pieces.label: V5 double-track curve R249/R282-45 on viaduct
pieces.notes: Double-track viaduct curve. length_mm/radius_mm given for the inner R249 rail; outer rail is R282 at the same 45-deg arc and continues to occupy 33 mm centers. Treat as a paired piece in the solver.

pieces.label: Double-track straight S248 (248 mm, 33 mm centers)
pieces.notes: Two-track-wide straight roadbed in a single piece, 33 mm centers.

pieces.label: Double-track straight S124 (124 mm, 33 mm centers)
pieces.notes: Half-length double-track straight.

pieces.label: #4 manual left turnout
pieces.notes: Main route is 124 mm (one S124). Divergence is geometric (built around R481 sub-radius diverging) rather than a published angle; field is null. Manual ground throw.

pieces.label: #4 manual right turnout
pieces.notes: Mirror of 20-201.

pieces.label: #4 electric (Electrofrog/snap) left turnout
pieces.notes: Powered version of 20-201. Kato part number convention for powered N #4 turnouts is sometimes printed as 20-202L / 20-202R; legacy stock may carry 20-201L. Verify SKU at point of sale.

pieces.label: #4 electric (Electrofrog/snap) right turnout
pieces.notes: Powered version of 20-202.

pieces.label: #6 manual left turnout
pieces.notes: Main route is 186 mm (one S186).

pieces.label: #6 manual right turnout
pieces.notes: Mirror of 20-203.

pieces.label: #6 electric left turnout
pieces.notes: Powered #6 left. Some lots ship as 20-205. Verify at dealer.

pieces.label: #6 electric right turnout
pieces.notes: Powered #6 right. Some lots ship as 20-206.

pieces.label: Y-point turnout (equilateral)
pieces.notes: Equilateral Y turnout; both legs diverge symmetrically. Powered switch machine. Overall length along main centerline is 124 mm.

pieces.label: Double crossover (33 mm centers)
pieces.notes: Single-piece double crossover, 33 mm centers, 248 mm overall along the main route. Includes powered switch machines.

pieces.label: 90-degree crossing (124 mm)
pieces.notes: 90-degree crossing diamond. SKU has shifted between catalog years; verify at dealer. Length along either axis is 124 mm.

pieces.label: 45-degree crossing
pieces.notes: Listed in the JP catalog. Dimensions/SKU for the NA-imported 45-degree crossing were not verified live for this build; left null pending source check.

pieces.label: Bumper / end-of-track buffer (66 mm)
pieces.notes: End-of-line buffer with integrated red LED (some variants). Typical printed length is 66 mm; older buffer-track packs (20-045) may differ. 2 per pack.

pieces.label: Magnetic uncoupler S124 (124 mm)
pieces.notes: Magnetic uncoupler ramp built into a 124 mm straight. Compatible with magnetic-knuckle couplers.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/kato-unitrack-n.md for per-system caveats.
